items.title: An Artinian ring has only finitely many maximal ideals
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that an Artinian ring has only finitely many maximal ideals (statement lines 12940-12943). The proof does not classify Artinian rings or use their dimension theory: it assumes infinitely many distinct maximal ideals, forms the chain of successive intersections, and obtains strictness of each step from the surjectivity of the maps into the products of the quotients supplied by the Chinese remainder theorem, which contradicts the descending chain condition (proof lines 12945-12953). The observation that distinctness of the maximal ideals is exactly what makes the chain strict is the content, and the author records it in one sentence. H2.
